notes.title: Major Update #2 - Hard Mode, Endless Mode, Resource Slider, Return to Vehicle
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2] 

A new Major Update for Riot Operator is up on the Default branch. We continue our mission of improving the game based on your feedback. This time we are adding some additional options that improve the game's replayability. While it's not possible for us to add the "play on any real map" feature, we hope that you will have fun with the new modes. Let's check all the new things coming your way!

[h2]Hard Mode and Endless Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Hard Mode[/b] was added to the game. 
[*] [b]Endless Mode[/b] was added to the game. 
[/list]
When starting a new scenario, you can now select a Hard Mode. Hard Mode scenarios have separate medals and include the following modifiers:
[list]
[*] NPC spawn is increased by around 30%, 
[*] The cooldown between incidents is decreased by 20%, 
[*] Damage to the player is increased by 100%. 
[/list]
Endless Mode on the other hand allows the player to continue playing after the Main Objective is finished. What's important - the Main Objective won't repeat itself once it's over. So the player can only interact with the side objectives and keep on buying new squads, tools, and vehicles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/5be5ee0811b5add51f8e109516ee9f8c9cd9c689.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new [b]Embark[/b] option has been added to Squads. Clicking on Embark (or pressing the "1" hotkey button) will cause the Squad to automatically go back to their last vehicle.
[*] A new [b]Resource Slider[/b] has been added to the game. Change your starting Money and set it between 0 and 100,000, to make the game harder or easier (or simply more fun due to a bigger number of squads). 
[*] A new option for changing the Camera angle has been added. Press the Middle Mouse Button to rotate the Camera to your liking. 
[*] The Pathfinding algorithm has been updated to ensure that the units (especially Vehicles) are more likely to stick to the roads.
[*] The Pathfinding algorithm has been updated to ensure that the units won't get stuck in between buildings when going to their desired location. 
[*] An issue with white clouds at maximum zoom-out affecting the visibility has been fixed. 
[*] An issue with the vehicles doing excessive drifts when turning has been fixed. 
[*] An issue with icons being affected by the bloom effect has been fixed. 
[*] An issue with London music sometimes overlapping two tracks over each other has been fixed. 
[*] Other stability changes have been introduced in order to ensure that the game will work without major performance drops with all the additional squads that the player can recruit due to Resource Slider and Endless Mode being introduced. 
[/list]
We hope that you will have fun with all the new changes in Major Update #2! If you haven't played the game yet, we also want to inform you, that we have just launched the highest up-to-date [b]-30% discount[/b] on Riot Operator. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454490/Riot_Operator/

Thank you for being with us and for all the recent kind words of encouragement. We are very happy to see that despite the rocky launch, there are still players who are invested in the game and willing to provide us with feedback. We hope that you will have a lovely Christmas season and a Happy New Year!

Best regards,
Riot Operator Team

notes.title: Major Update #1 - Visual Overhaul, Cheaper Units, Arrest Cooldown Removed
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

A new Major Update #1 is now available on the Default branch! We have been analyzing your reviews and surveys to see which changes we can implement first. We have seen some mentions that the game is too blue and that the visual side of the game isn't very appealing. That's why we have decided to overhaul the visuals. You can compare the results below: 

[b]Previous Version:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/9dee2e8993d083a875bee4f50cf8afee5ab5e95f.png[/img]

[b]Current Version: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/93daeb2893b9ca49d55c56c80af4179e9ffaa9a8.png[/img]

Other than that we have decided to focus on improving the efficiency of the units and their tools and making them cheaper, due to several requests in this area. We hope that all those changes will make Riot Operator a more enjoyable experience for you. A full list of changes can be found below. 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Visual Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Several materials have been reworked in order to make the game look better,
[*] Post Processing settings have been reworked in order to make the game look better,
[*] Minimap Colors were modified for better readability,
[*] Minimap Icons were updated for better readability.
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] The cost of a single Police Unit has been reduced from 1000 to 750, 
[*] The cost of a single Paramedic Unit has been reduced from 3000 to 2000,
[*] The Police's arrest action has been made global for all the Police units, regardless of itemization. 
[*] The cooldown for the Police's arrest action has been removed. Instead of reducing the cooldown, handcuffs will now affect the squad's handcuffing speed, 
[*] The Paramedics' incident detection range has been increased by 200% to ensure better responsiveness, 
[*] The Tear Gas range has been increased by 100%,
[*] The Water Cannon Truck and Tear Gas Gun have been reworked to have a small chance of triggering the flee action when used on the Rioters, 
[*] All the starting units have been reworked to include Vehicles in their squads. 
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] An option to quickly wear items by double-clicking on them in the Shop has been added, 
[*] An option to multi-deselect units using shift has been added, 
[*] Selecting multiple units has been reworked to allow the usage of the actions that the selected squads have, 
[*] A new "baton" icon has been added for the Police units that got aggressive due to low stress level, 
[*] Minimap icons for the player-controlled units have been updated. 
[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3] 
[list]
[*] New lines were added to the Tutorial to explain some features more clearly. 
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] An issue that prevented the Players from overwriting a save when reaching a maximum save capacity has been fixed,
[*] An issue with squad formations getting stuck in the crowd when not intended has been solved, 
[*] An issue with some texts containing errors has been fixed, 
[*] An issue with the visuals of the map's edge not displaying correctly has been fixed,
[*] An issue that could've resulted in the player getting stuck in the Tutorial has been fixed,
[*] An issue that could've resulted in some text lines getting skipped when not intended in the Tutorial has been fixed. 
[/list]
[h3]Community Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Obtainable Steam Cards have been added,
[*] Obtainable Emojis have been added,
[*] Obtainable Badges have been added,
[*] Obtainable Profile Backgrounds have been added. 
[/list]
[h2]New Demo[/h2]

A new Demo for the Riot Operator is now available on Steam. It includes the tutorial and a single mission (London). If you weren't certain about buying Riot Operators due to the latest reviews, you can now test the newest iteration of the game (including all the newest changes mentioned above) for free. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454490/Riot_Operator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/3895f9a44cfa0399831da68b88fa7128895b15b9.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Survey and your Feedback[/h2]

If you have any further requests regarding the new features or changes that you would like to see in the game, please let us know in the comments below the announcement or via the in-game Survey. At the same time, we want to thank you for all the Feedback that you are sending our way. We know that you care about the game and it's important for us to ensure that we will do our best to improve as many things as possible. 

We hope that this newest build will make your experience more enjoyable. Have fun! 

Best regards,
Beta 2 Games Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - New mission order + all missions unlocked
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

Thank you, everyone, for giving Riot Operator a chance. We are aware that many of you have expected more from this game. So at the beginning, we want to address this subject directly. 

Many of you have hoped for this game to be a sequel to 911 Operator or 112 Operator games. But the truth is, those games - while still indie - were made by a much bigger team, Jutsu Games. The team that is currently developing Infection Free Zone. Riot Operator was developed by the Beta 2 Games team, a much smaller studio based in Brazil, that has much smaller experience in creating PC games. 

Of course, we understand that in your eyes this does not justify us in any way. Because at the end of the day, what you care about most is being able to play a good game. That's why we only want to ask for one thing. For your patience. We will do our best to improve the Riot Operator as much as we can over the upcoming updates. 

[h2]Update 1.0.1[/h2]

In this quick update, we are introducing two important changes:
[list]
[*] Mission order has been rearranged to ensure a better gaming experience. Some players have reported that there was too much healing in the Hong Kong mission, while they want to enjoy some police action from the get-go. 
[*] All the missions have been unlocked and made available from the very beginning. It's now up to you to decide in which order you want to tackle the missions and complete them all. 
[/list]
[h2]Next Steps[/h2]

Of course, this is just the beginning. After the weekend, we will be gathering all the feedback we have received via reviews, surveys, and bug reports. We will do our best to analyze your suggestions and remarks and decide which changes are the most crucial and important to introduce first. 

Thank you for sharing all your issues with us. Knowing the exact things that you find dissatisfying makes this hard work easier for us. If you still haven't shared your feedback with us, we would appreciate sending it via the in-game Survey. 

Best regards,
Riot Operator Team

notes.title: Riot Operator release date has been announced!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators! [/h2]

Closed Beta tests are officially over. We have gathered all your feedback and analyzed the most important issues and points that were brought to our attention. We have shortened the Scanerios and made the gameplay a bit more dynamic by increasing the number of side missions as the Scenario continues. We have fixed some commonly reported bugs and now testing the last improvements. [b]The wait is finally over[/b]. 

[h2]Launch date[/h2]

We are excited to let you know that Riot Operator will launch on Steam on [b]October 25, 2024[/b], during the Games Operators Publisher Sale. The game will be available with a -10% time-limited launch discount. The long-time fans of our titles can also expect an additional discount through the bundles. More info about that coming upon launch! 

[h2]What to expect upon launch?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unique mixture of RTS and simulation gameplay,
[*] 3 main types of units - Police, Medics and Firefighters, 
[*] 8 different Scenarios taking place in cities across the world: Hong Kong, Warsaw, London, Berlin, Brasilia, Atlanta, Paris, and Washington D.C., 
[*] Our dedication to follow your feedback. We don't plan to stop the development upon the release. We will closely observe all the surveys and bug reports coming our way to introduce the necessary changes and bug fixes.
[/list]
Thank you for following the Riot Operator's announcements for these past few years. We are extremely happy to be finally releasing the game. It was a long development and we hope that you will enjoy what we have prepared for you! 

Best regards,
Beta 2 Games Team

notes.title: Development Status Update #8 - Advanced Police Vehicles
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

Today we are proud to show you two new vehicles that are joining the police forces - the Riot Truck and the Water Cannon Truck! While the basic Police Car has only two slots for the police staff and limited usability, those two new advanced vehicles provide additional power if you can afford them. 

[h2]Riot Truck [/h2]

Riot Trucks have two significant advantages over the basic Police Car: 
[list]
[*] An ability to transport a full police squad consisting of 5 members, 
[*] A special frontal construction that allows them to move faster through the crowds of protesters. 
[/list] 
When every second matters, the Riot Truck can help you with getting your Police Units to where they are needed the most. Check how the Riot Trucks perform in the videos below:

[previewyoutube=xWX8jTUtKQg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Water Cannon Truck[/h2]

Water Cannon Truck doesn't allow to transport the whole Police Squad, but its strength lies elsewhere. Water Cannon Truck will help you control large groups of aggressive protesters marching at you. While very strong, it also has a significant cost. Always ensure that your Water Cannon Truck is exactly where it's needed. 

[previewyoutube=BfwqYEa6Wus;full]https://youtu.be/BfwqYEa6Wus[/previewyoutube]
What do you think about those two newest additions? Share your feedback with us! 

Best regards,
Beta 2 Games Team

notes.title: Riot Operator - Post Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

The dust has settled and we finally have a moment to summarize the last Steam Next Fest that we have joined with Riot Operator. First of all - a huge thank you to everyone who played the game during the event. We are glad that so many players gave Riot Operator a chance. What's also very inspiring - the reception of the game is also better than ever. 

[h2]Steam Next Fest Summary[/h2]

Before we launched the demo for the Steam Next Fest, we did a quick closed test with a limited group of fans. We have received a lot of honest feedback and a lot of issues were brought to our attention. We started tackling them one by one, focusing on the areas that were mentioned most frequently. 

This approach has brought us some great results. While the game is still in progress, we are happy to let you know, that basically all the areas were rated higher after the Steam Next Fest. To summarize some stats from the survey for you:

Average Rating: 7,03/10
Performance Rating: 4,39/5 
Visual Rating: 3,35/5 
Audio Rating: 3,10/5  

While the visual and audio side of the game is meant to be minimalistic, we will see what we can do about improving these areas. Other than that, we were surprised to notice that:
[list]
[*] Riot Dispersing, while often rated as a mechanic that requires further improvements, was also considered the most enjoyable element of the game,
[*] A huge majority of players (88%) have declared that the game's setting is non-controversial,
[*] The reputation system, GUI, and color schemes were not understandable enough for players. 
[/list]
[h2]Next Steps[/h2]

What now? We will keep on working hard on Riot Operator. While we are aware that the development is taking longer than expected, we still want to deliver a fine gaming experience your way. Right now, we mainly focus on:

[list]
[*] Implementation of other scenarios,
[*] Improvements in the Riot Dispersing system,
[*] Improvements to the Path Finding,
[*] Changes to the GUI and the color schemes, 
[*] Bug Fixing. 
[/list]
Thank you once again for your ongoing support. We will keep on doing our best so you find Riot Operator a satisfying gaming experience at launch. 

Best regards,
Riot Operator Team

notes.title: Development Status Update #5 - Vehicles
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

Best wishes from the Beta 2 Games team to all our followers in the New Year! We hope to finally deliver Riot Operator to you in 2023, even though we don't have the exact launch date for you yet. Still, we recommend checking our announcements on regular basis to stay updated about potential upcoming beta tests for the game! 

[h2]Vehicles[/h2]

Playing Riot Operator is all about efficiency. Your budget is limited and you will have to constantly assess whether it's better to hire new units or provide your experienced members with a new vehicle. The advantage is obvious - a vehicle allows you to move across the map faster. It becomes especially important when people's lives are at stake and every minute counts. Moving your units with an ambulance, fire truck or police car will allow you to react to incidents swiftly. But the number of units a vehicle can hold is limited.

For example - the most basic police car for the police units is relatively cheap and very fast. You can move from one end of the map to another in a blink of an eye. But this vehicle is adapted to having two police units on board. Such a small unit can react to a smaller incident but won't be able to deal with a huge group of protesters. Proper planning is mandatory in order to achieve success. 

[h2]Let's see them in action! [/h2]

Below you can see some examples of how different vehicles look in the game right now.

notes.title: Development Status Update #4 - Police Equipment
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators! [/h2]

We have shown you the barriers last month, and now it's time to take a closer look at the full range of equipment that is available to the police units! While medics and firefighters don't have as many tools at their disposal, it's always good to analyze your current needs, when it comes to the police. Are there any aggressive rioters? Do you have to close the movement for certain streets? Prepare for your job accordingly and your duty will get way easier. 

[h2]Police Equipment[/h2]
You can equip your units with the following equipment:
[list]
[*] [b]Barriers[/b] - to stop the movement in certain areas,
[*] [b]Plastic handcuffs[/b] - very useful when dealing with aggressive rioters. Arresting agitators will help you with controlling the crowds.  Mind you, arresting too many rioters will result in a negative reputation! 
[*] [b]Police batons[/b] - increases the offensive capability of the unit. Ordering the units to fight with batons will cause casualties on both sides. Always have your medics close if it seems like you won't be able to avoid the confrontation. 
[*] [b]Shields[/b] - increases the defensive capability of the unit. Holding your ground is not an easy job. You can expect some of the rioters to throw nearby objects at you. Large police shields will help with ensuring that the damage on your side will be kept at a minimum. 
[*][b] Tear Gas [/b]- allows you to disperse huge aggressive crowds that are not willing to move. Mind you, hurting peaceful protesters with tear gas will also result in a negative reputation. 
[/list]
As you can see, the equipment is varied and has to be used mindfully. You have to be as efficient, as possible, while causing the least possible damage. Becoming too aggressive will result in drops in reputation. While you can make some mistakes, remember that a negative reputation means you are going to lose the mission. 

[h2]How do they work[/h2]
Let's take a quick look at the current visualization of two mechanics, that are related to the equipment mentioned above - arresting with plastic handcuffs and dispersing the crowd with tear gas. 

[previewyoutube=VzUJrQ-_M7E;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=yFlToYZjJMA;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope that this announcement and the videos have provided you with a little bit more advanced insight into the police units. Let us know how you feel about those tools at your disposal! How would you equip your own police units? 

Best regards,
Riot Operator Team

notes.title: Development Status Update #2
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

The second Development Update is here! The vertical Slice phase of the development is officially over and now we are working on the alpha build for Riot Operator. We know that we aren't posting as often, as you would like us to, but hopefully, you will like all the new elements that we are implementing in the game. Let's take a quick look at the recent changes!

[h2]Score System Overhaul[/h2]

Previously, the player was obtaining or losing points based on his actions towards the main objective. Additional points were possible to get when completing side incidents. The system was fair but felt unrewarding at times. We have recently made adjustments to it, providing the player with points dynamically based on their actions. For example - now it's possible to fail a side mission, which tells us to chase away rioters from a place, but still gain points due to attending to the wounded with medic units and taking care of peoples' health. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/b91516ea8b0317904d4df194830e212d9acd7d11.png[/img]

[h2]New Mission Objectives[/h2]

Every mission is going to consist of a main objective and side incidents happening all over the map. We are currently fleshing out those actions that you will have to take care of during each mission. For example, during the stage which takes place in Warsaw, Poland, the player is going to have to take care of marching protesters and protect them from aggressive rioters. Being in the move and reacting quickly is going to be the main goal of this mission. In the meantime, other stages might tell you to stop the rioters from gathering at one important point on the map, making it all more about planning and preparing. 

BONUS: A quick image from a side incident, where firemen are putting out the fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/47a416e94a528c5dd30c734c8ce99a2ae58d5871.png[/img]

[h2]Default units, squad duplicating[/h2]

When playing the early builds of the game, we have noticed that it's quite hard to build the whole squad from the scratch at the beginning. That's why we have decided to implement two important features - default units and squad duplicating. Default units are going to be given to the player at the beginning of each mission, so we have some basic setup to rely on. Usually, it's going to be one unit of policemen, medics, and firefighters. Squad duplicating allows for quick duplication of the currently existing squad with all the attached equipment. It saves us a lot of time and allows for running adjustments in a matter of seconds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/c25f20db85d54b83f9de31f639f243e3ee812c05.png[/img]

Of course, other than that, we are adding several other new features to the game, and continue on adding new scenarios and incidents that can happen on the map. On top of it, it's very important for us to prepare a solid AI for the protesters and rioters and this element is being improved with every iteration. There's still some time before we are going to reach the Beta phase, but we expect that moment to be especially interesting to you, as closed tests are going to be conducted at that point.

Thank you for following Riot Operator!

Best regards,
Beta 2 Games Team

notes.title: Development Status Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

The Steam Page has been published for a while now, but we haven't had a chance to talk to you directly yet. We are Beta 2 Games and in co-operation with our publisher, Games Operators, we are creating Riot Operator, an exciting simulation game about riot control management. This is our biggest project up to date, so keep your fingers crossed for us! We want to do our best with this game! 

[h2]Vertical Slice[/h2]

So where are we exactly at the moment? We are finishing the "vertical slice" phase, which is considered a small, fully playable portion of the game, containing most of the mechanics that are planned for the full project scope. Some minor visual improvements have also been made and the game is shaping up to look really nice in its minimalistic aesthetic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39367120/cefdcd25ed330c03425f08d45e45972a7988d318.png[/img]

After that, we will work on the alpha build and later on - the beta build - which might be especially interesting for you, if you want to play the game early and share your feedback with us. 

[h2]Release date[/h2]

Our current plan is to launch the game at the beginning of Q4 2022. So there are still at least 9 months of hard work ahead of us. Mind you, we are planning to run some extensive community and closed beta tests. So the final decision is going to be made only after we can see your feedback. If the game's early reviews are going to be unsatisfying, we might delay this launch even further. 

[h2]Early Gameplay Teaser[/h2]

If you're interested in the progress we are making with the game, we are happy to present you with this short gameplay teaser, recorded 100% from within the game. What's important - this game is still a work in progress and might change a lot! It applies to both the visual side of the project and the gameplay logic itself. For example - we are constantly making improvements to the rioters' AI, to make this part of gameplay really satisfying. 

[b]What do you think about this gameplay teaser? Let us know in the comments, we are really interested in your initial reactions to it! [/b]

[previewyoutube=mk8LFaLWqHc;full][/previewyoutube]

Best regards,
Beta 2 Games and Games Operators Teams
